Horticalc 0.6.7 adds stock preparation to Calculator and Solver recipes.
Set the finished stock volume and concentration, assign products to A/B/C
or separate additions, then copy or print the preparation instructions.

## Highlights

- Stock quantities and dosing come from the existing recipe. Changing the batch
  volume updates the dose while keeping the stock volume and concentration fixed.
- Optional tank suggestions use the fertilizer compositions already in the
  database. Checks compare different products; they do not certify a mixture's
  solubility, compatibility, or shelf life.
- Stock preparation uses RO/distilled water. The resulting nutrient calculation
  accounts for stock doses replacing part of the batch water.
- Saved recipes retain stock settings. Incomplete assignments, insufficient
  stock, and unreviewed product changes block preparation exports.
- Added T.A. Flora Micro Hard Water data and updated the former GHE product names.
- Windows Setup now offers installation or uninstall when an existing installation
  is found, while preserving saved user data.
- Fixed premature connection-disconnect signals in the HTTP body limiter, which
  could interrupt frontend delivery with newer framework versions.
- Updated Python dependencies, packaging tools, and release actions. Updated
  frontend development dependencies to address the fast-uri and js-yaml advisories.
